description: This file defines the interface and class for the DRM manager service in Android, including methods for managing DRM rights, sessions, and metadata.

classes.name: DrmManagerService
classes.description: Implementation class for DRM manager service, delegating to DrmManager, providing methods for DRM rights and session management.

methods.name: instantiate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the DRM manager service.

methods.name: addUniqueId
methods.description: Adds a unique identifier for a client.

methods.name: removeUniqueId
methods.description: Removes a client by its unique identifier.

methods.name: addClient
methods.description: Registers a new client with a unique ID.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Deregisters a client.

methods.name: setDrmServiceListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for DRM service events.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves DRM constraints for a given path and action.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves DRM metadata for a given path.

methods.name: canHandle
methods.description: Checks if the service can handle a specific MIME type and path.

methods.name: processDrmInfo
methods.description: Processes DRM information.

methods.name: acquireDrmInfo
methods.description: Acquires DRM information request.

methods.name: saveRights
methods.description: Saves DRM rights to specified paths.

methods.name: getOriginalMimeType
methods.description: Gets the original MIME type of a DRM object.

methods.name: getDrmObjectType
methods.description: Gets the DRM object type.

methods.name: checkRightsStatus
methods.description: Checks the rights status for a given path and action.

methods.name: consumeRights
methods.description: Consumes rights for a DRM object.

methods.name: setPlaybackStatus
methods.description: Sets playback status for a DRM session.

methods.name: validateAction
methods.description: Validates an action on a DRM object.

methods.name: removeRights
methods.description: Removes rights for a given path.

methods.name: removeAllRights
methods.description: Removes all rights for a client.

methods.name: openConvertSession
methods.description: Opens a conversion session for DRM data.

methods.name: convertData
methods.description: Converts DRM data.

methods.name: closeConvertSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM conversion session.

methods.name: getAllSupportInfo
methods.description: Retrieves all supported DRM info.

methods.name: openDecryptSession
methods.description: Opens a DRM decryption session with various overloads.

methods.name: closeDecryptSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM decryption session.

methods.name: initializeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Initializes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption.

methods.name: finalizeDecryptUnit
methods.description: Finalizes a decrypt unit.

methods.name: pread
methods.description: Reads data from a decrypted session.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Dumps the state of the DRM service for debugging.
